method_docs.compiler/rustc_mir_transform/src/dataflo: Checks whether the MIR pass should run by querying `mir_opt_level` and enabling `DataflowConstProp` only at optimization level 3 or higher.

Drives the full constant-propagation pass: it checks `mir_opt_level`, skips overly large bodies, builds the tracking `Map` with `Map::new`, constructs the analysis with `ConstAnalysis::new`, runs it to a fixpoint via `wrap`, `into_engine`, and `iterate_to_fixpoint`, then collects replacements with `visit_reachable_with` and applies them with `visit_body_preserves_cfg`.
Returns the analysis tracking map stored in the analysis state.

Handles a discriminant write by first invalidating tracked discriminant information with `flood_discr`, then, if the place’s discriminant is tracked, computing the concrete discriminant with `eval_discriminant` and recording it with `assign_discr`.

Applies transfer effects for assignments. For `Use` and `CopyForDeref`, it invalidates the destination and calls `assign_operand` when the target place is tracked. For aggregates, it invalidates the target, uses `map`/`apply` to locate tracked fields and variants, fills field values via `assign_operand`, and may compute enum discriminants with `eval_discriminant`. For other rvalues, it delegates value computation to `handle_operand`, `binary_op`, or direct state assignment logic depending on the rvalue kind.

Evaluates selected rvalues to constant lattice values. It computes array lengths, constant casts, binary and unary operations, size/offset queries, and discriminants; this method calls `eval_operand`, `binary_op`, `wrap_immediate`, and `map`, and falls back to `super_rvalue` for unsupported cases.
Evaluates a MIR constant operand with `try_eval_scalar` and returns either a known scalar constant or `Top` if evaluation fails.

Resolves `SwitchInt` branching from the current abstract value of the discriminant. It calls `handle_operand` to read the operand, uses `state.get_idx` when the operand is a tracked place, and returns no edges for `Bottom`, a single edge for a known scalar target, or the original switch for unknown values.
Constructs a `ConstAnalysis` by computing the body’s normalized parameter environment and initializing the tracking map, local declarations, and interpreter context.

Assigns a tracked destination from an operand. For copies and moves, it either links tracked places directly or, for dereferences of known pointers, calls `assign_constant` to materialize the pointee value. For constant operands, it evaluates the constant and then calls `assign_constant`.

Projects a concrete interpreter operand through MIR projections and writes any recoverable constant subvalues into tracked places. It resolves dynamic indices when possible, uses the interpreter to project through fields, variants, discriminants, and deref lengths, and finally stores scalar results after converting them with `wrap_immediate`.

Evaluates a binary operation in the lattice. It calls `eval_operand` on both inputs, uses the interpreter’s `overflowing_binary_op` when both are known, and otherwise performs a few algebraic simplifications for partially known operands.

Evaluates an operand to an immediate lattice value. It calls `handle_operand` to obtain either a direct value or tracked place, reads tracked-place values from the state when needed, and converts known scalars into `ImmTy` using layout information.
Computes the scalar discriminant value for a specific enum variant by querying layout information and the interpreter; returns `None` for non-enum types or failed evaluation.
Converts an interpreter `Immediate` into the scalar lattice, yielding a known scalar for `Immediate::Scalar`, `Bottom` for uninitialized data, and `Top` otherwise.

While visiting operands, tries to replace place operands with constants by calling `try_make_constant`; if that fails for a projected place, it delegates to `super_operand` so nested `Index` projections can still be processed.
Returns `false` to disable alignment enforcement in the dummy interpreter used by constant propagation. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Returns `false` to disable validity checking for layouts in the dummy interpreter. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.

Rejects writes to globals and rejects reads from mutable global allocations so const propagation only accesses immutable global data; otherwise it succeeds with `Ok(())`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub hook for resolving or evaluating function calls in the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub hook for handling non-unwinding panics in the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub hook for intrinsic evaluation in the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub hook for handling assertion panics in the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Rejects pointer arithmetic/comparison-style binary pointer operations by immediately stopping interpretation with an error. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub hook for exposing a pointer in the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub hook for initializing per-frame extra state in the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Returns an empty stack slice so span lookup and constant evaluation can proceed without panicking when no real interpreter stack is maintained. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.
Stub mutable-stack accessor for the dummy interpreter; it is currently `unimplemented!()`. It does not call any other methods in the Methods List.

Constructs a `CollectAndPatch` with the given type context and local declarations, initializing both internal hash maps with `FxHashMap::default`. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.
Builds a constant `Operand` from a `ScalarInt` and type by wrapping the scalar in a MIR `Constant`. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

For assignment statements, scans the assigned rvalue before the statement effect to collect constant operands reachable from the current dataflow state. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

After an assignment executes, records the assigned place's known integer constant in `assignments` unless the rvalue already uses a constant operand, preserving existing spans. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.
Scans a terminator before its effect to collect constant operands from the current state for later MIR patching. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.
Returns the stored `TyCtxt` for the mutating visitor. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Rewrites a statement at a recorded assignment location into `Rvalue::Use` of a propagated constant operand, computing the rvalue type and calling `CollectAndPatch::make_operand`; otherwise it delegates traversal to `super_statement`. It explicitly calls `CollectAndPatch::make_operand` from the provided Methods List.

Replaces copy/move operands with propagated constant operands when a pre-effect constant was collected for that place; for projected places without a direct replacement, it continues recursive traversal. It explicitly calls `CollectAndPatch::make_operand` from the provided Methods List.

Converts an indexed projection into a `ConstantIndex` when the index local has a known pre-effect integer constant and the offset can be materialized safely; otherwise leaves the projection unchanged. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

When visiting a local used by copy or move, records its known integer constant from the current dataflow state into the patch visitor's `before_effect` map for later operand replacement. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Provides the `Machine` hook for alignment-check failures but intentionally leaves it unimplemented, so this path is not handled in the dummy interpreter. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Initializes the entry state as reachable with all tracked values at bottom, then floods each argument place to top by calling `State::flood`; it also queries the analysis `map` to size storage and resolve tracked arguments.
Applies statement effects only when the domain state is reachable, checking via `State::is_reachable` and then calling the wrapped analysis's `handle_statement`.
Applies terminator effects only for reachable states by calling `State::is_reachable`; if reachable it calls `handle_terminator`, otherwise it returns no edges.
Applies post-call effects only when the state is reachable, checking via `State::is_reachable` and then calling `handle_call_return`.
No-op hook for per-edge `SwitchInt` effects; it calls no other listed methods.

Creates a cloned `State` by cloning the wrapped inner state data. Calls `clone` on `self.0`.
Reuses existing allocation to copy another `State` into `self` by delegating to the inner state storage. Calls `clone_from` on `self.0` with `source.0`.
Checks whether the analysis state is currently in the `Reachable` variant.
Marks the entire analysis state as unreachable by replacing the inner state with `StateData::Unreachable`.
Invalidates every tracked value in a reachable state with lattice top. Calls `flood_all_with` with `V::TOP`.
Overwrites every tracked value in a reachable state with the provided value; does nothing if the state is unreachable.
Invalidates a place and all aliasing tracked places with the provided value in a reachable state. Calls `Map::for_each_aliasing_place` and clones the replacement value for each alias.
Invalidates a place and its aliases with lattice top. Calls `flood_with` with `V::TOP`.

Invalidates the discriminant of a place and all aliasing discriminant projections with the provided value. Calls `Map::for_each_aliasing_place` with `TrackElem::Discriminant` and clones the replacement value for each alias.
Invalidates a place discriminant and its aliasing discriminants with lattice top. Calls `flood_discr_with` with `V::TOP`.

Stores a concrete value into the tracked value slot for the target place if that place has one; does nothing for unreachable state or untracked targets.

Copies tracked data from a source place tree into the corresponding target place tree: it copies the direct tracked value when both sides have value slots, then recursively copies matching child projections. Calls `Map::children`, looks up matching projections via `map.projections.get`, and recursively calls `insert_place_idx` on corresponding children.

Implements assignment to a place by first invalidating the target and aliases, then inserting the resulting value or copied place if the target is tracked. Calls `flood`, `Map::find`, and `insert_idx`.

Implements assignment to a place discriminant by first invalidating the discriminant and aliasing discriminants, then inserting the result if the discriminant is tracked. Calls `flood_discr`, `Map::find_discr`, and `insert_idx`.
Returns the tracked value for a place, or `V::TOP` if the place is not tracked. Calls `Map::find` and `get_idx`.
Returns the tracked discriminant value for a place, or `V::TOP` if no discriminant place is tracked. Calls `Map::find_discr` and `get_idx`.
Returns the tracked slice-length value for a place, or `V::TOP` if no length projection is tracked. Calls `Map::find_len` and `get_idx`.

Returns the value stored for a tracked place index: in reachable state it reads and clones the place's value slot when present or yields `V::TOP` when absent, and in unreachable state it returns `V::BOTTOM`.

Joins another state into `self` using reachability-aware lattice semantics: unreachable `other` has no effect, unreachable `self` becomes a clone of `other`, and two reachable states delegate to their inner join. Calls `clone` when replacing an unreachable `self` and calls `join` on the reachable inner state data.
Constructs and initializes a tracking map, computes excluded locals, registers all tracked places, and returns the populated map. Calls `excluded_locals` and `register`.

Builds the complete place/projection tracking structure for the MIR body: initializes bare locals, expands projected children from a worklist subject to an optional value limit, and then precomputes each place's nested value range. Calls `register_children` while seeding locals and while processing the worklist, and calls `cache_preorder_invoke` when caching nested value ranges.

Registers immediate tracked structure for a place type: allocates a value slot for scalar places, creates dedicated discriminant and slice-length children when applicable, and enqueues field projections for later expansion. Calls `iter_fields` to enumerate fields and pushes resulting child work items onto the worklist.

Performs a preorder traversal from a root place to cache the contiguous range of nested `ValueIndex` entries reachable from that place. Recursively calls `cache_preorder_invoke` on each child via `ensure_sufficient_stack`.
Returns the number of tracked value slots in the map.
Looks up the tracked child place produced by applying one projection element to a place and returns it if present.

Resolves a MIR place plus extra tracking projections into a tracked `PlaceIndex` by starting from the local root and applying each projection step in order. Calls `apply` for each MIR projection element and each extra `TrackElem`.
Resolves an ordinary MIR place to its tracked `PlaceIndex`. Calls `find_extra` with no extra projection elements.
Resolves the tracked discriminant projection for a MIR place. Calls `find_extra` with `TrackElem::Discriminant`.
Resolves the tracked slice-length projection for a MIR place. Calls `find_extra` with `TrackElem::DerefLen`.
Returns an iterator over the direct children of a tracked place by calling `Children::new`.

Visits all value slots that may alias the given place (including parents, variant/discriminant siblings, and nested values). Visits value slots contained in sibling variant/discriminant children of a parent, excluding an optionally preserved child. It calls `children` to iterate siblings and `for_each_value_inside` to visit each invalidated sibling subtree.
Applies the callback to every value index stored inside the subtree rooted at the given place by iterating the precomputed inner-value range.

Traverses a tracked place subtree while propagating a projected abstract value to descendants. It calls `children` to iterate child places, uses the provided `project` callback to derive child values, invokes `f` for places that have a value slot, and recursively calls `for_each_projection_value` on reachable children.
Constructs a `PlaceInfo` with the given projection element and all links/value slots initialized to `None`.
Constructs a child iterator positioned at the parent's first child.
Advances the child iterator by returning the current child and updating the cursor to that child's `next_sibling`.
Converts supported MIR projection elements into tracking elements: `Field` becomes `TrackElem::Field`, `Downcast` becomes `TrackElem::Variant`, and all other projections are rejected with `Err(())`.

Enumerates the fields of tuples, non-union ADTs, and closures, normalizing field types when needed and invoking the supplied callback for each field. For closure upvars, it recursively calls `iter_fields` on the tupled upvars type.
